plan.comparison: Matched support, at most unit gross and zero net targets; not matched beta, volatility, borrow or execution
plan.endpoint_scope: Positive entry/exit source volume masks outcomes only; unknown held outcomes withhold curves
plan.factor_scope: Nine explicit ETF return proxies; no inferred stock sectors or factor-neutral portfolio claim

parent.availability: Historical daily completion assumed by next local midnight; actual receipts are not backdated
parent.corporate_action_scope: Alpaca all-adjusted return proxies; no physical shares, dividend payment timing or historical borrow claim
parent.eligibility_scope: Consecutive observed past bars and all finite features; no future outcome membership selection
parent.inference_scope: Descriptive per-fold Rank IC and HAC; no adaptive-selection correction or promotion gate
parent.missing_label_scope: Any missing predicted outcome withholds that date's IC; unavailable expected dates withhold complete-fold inference
parent.mse_scope: Pooled paired date-symbol forecast errors versus the same training-mean support; descriptive, not independent row inference
parent.payoff_scope: Nonoverlapping fixed-horizon rank baskets; unknown held outcomes withhold the full curve; no borrow or funding modeled
parent.selection_clock: observed_at is the final source receipt of the completed hashed liquidity screen, not its acquisition start
parent.training_scope: Per-cohort pooled equal-weight eligible date-symbol rows; strictly mature labels before refit; train-only scaling
parent.universe_scope: Current membership and liquidity conditioned historical development; not point-in-time constituents

plan.rank_blend: Equal average percentile ranks of reversal60 and volatility20 on common support
plan.rank_ties: Average percentile score ranks; shared equal-weight boundary-tie basket policy
plan.residual_rank_blend: Equal average percentile ranks of rank_blend and residual_momentum on common support
plan.risk_attribution: Past-only ETF loadings at each decision; missing held loadings withhold complete exposure
plan.scope: Post-selection current-cohort historical development; no independent validation or broker fills
plan.source: Hash-bound retained parent and all inspected members; artifact reads are not provider observations
plan.support: Common finite past-only features and frozen parent Ridge; future labels never select members
plan.training: No supervised refitting; original parent finite-price Ridge training is unchanged
plan.uncertainty: Expected-date paired IC with shared HAC20; paired baskets descriptive without significance claims
